info.title: Upload-Post API
info.description: Upload-Post is a unified social media API that allows you to upload videos, photos, text, and documents to 22 social media platforms (TikTok, Instagram, LinkedIn, YouTube, Facebook, X/Twitter, Threads, Pinterest, Bluesky, Reddit, Discord, Telegram, WordPress and more) with a single API call. Features include scheduling, queue system, async uploads, FFmpeg media processing, analytics, webhooks, and white-label user management.

post.description: Upload a video to one or more social media platforms. Supports TikTok, Instagram, LinkedIn, YouTube, Facebook, X (Twitter), Threads, Pinterest, Bluesky, Reddit, Discord, and Telegram. Supports immediate, async, scheduled, and queued uploads.

video.description: The video file to upload (binary file) or a public video URL.

title.description: Default title/caption of the video. Required for YouTube and Reddit; optional for all other platforms. Platform-specific titles override this.

description.description: Optional extended text used on LinkedIn commentary, Facebook descriptions, YouTube descriptions, and Pinterest notes. Ignored elsewhere.

scheduled_date.description: ISO-8601 date/time to schedule publishing (e.g., '2025-12-31T23:45:00Z'). Must be in the future (≤365 days). Omit for immediate upload. Cannot be used with `add_to_queue`.

timezone.description: IANA timezone identifier (e.g., 'Europe/Madrid', 'America/New_York'). If provided, `scheduled_date` is interpreted in this timezone. Defaults to UTC.

async_upload.description: If true, returns immediately with a `request_id` and processes in the background. If false but upload takes >59s, automatically switches to async.

add_to_queue.description: If true, automatically schedules the post to the next available queue slot. Cannot be used with `scheduled_date`.

first_comment.description: Automatically post a first comment after publishing. Supported on Instagram, Facebook, Threads, Bluesky, Reddit, X, YouTube, and LinkedIn.

first_comment_media[].description: Image files to attach to the first comment as inline images. Currently supported on Reddit. Not available for scheduled or queued posts.

facebook_title.description: [Facebook] Specific title. Fallbacks to `title`. Ignored if facebook_media_type is STORIES.

threads_topic_tag.description: [Threads] A topic tag for the post (1-50 characters). Cannot contain periods (.) or ampersands (&). One tag per post.

cover_timestamp.description: [TikTok] Timestamp in milliseconds for video cover.

brand_content_toggle.description: [TikTok] Set to true for paid partnerships promoting third-party brands.

brand_organic_toggle.description: [TikTok] Set to true when promoting the creator's own business.

share_to_feed.description: [Instagram] Whether to share to feed (only for regular Reels, not Trial Reels).

collaborators.description: [Instagram] Comma-separated list of collaborator usernames. Not available for Trial Reels.

cover_url.description: [Instagram] URL for custom video cover. Alternative to cover_image binary upload.

cover_image.description: [Instagram] Binary cover image for Reels (JPEG, max 8MB). If both cover_image and cover_url are provided, cover_url takes precedence.

audio_name.description: [Instagram] Name of the audio track embedded in your video (Reels only).

is_ai_generated.description: Cross-platform AI-disclosure flag. Set to `true` to self-disclose the content as AI-generated. On Instagram (Reels, photos, carousels) it is forwarded as Meta's `is_ai_generated` and shows the "AI info" label under the account name; the label cannot be added or removed after publishing. On TikTok it maps to `is_aigc`, on YouTube to `containsSyntheticMedia` and on X to `made_with_ai`; a platform-specific value takes precedence over this alias. See the AI Content Labeling guide.

linkedin_description.description: [LinkedIn] Sent as the LinkedIn commentary. If omitted, reuses `title`.

target_linkedin_page_id.description: [LinkedIn] LinkedIn page ID to upload to an organization page.

thumbnail.description: [YouTube] Custom thumbnail image file (JPG/PNG/GIF/BMP, max 50MB). On Shorts it is set once YouTube finishes processing.

thumbnail_url.description: [YouTube] Alternative: provide thumbnail as a public URL.

containsSyntheticMedia.description: [YouTube] Declaration that video contains AI-generated content.

defaultLanguage.description: [YouTube] Language of title and description (BCP-47 code, e.g., 'es', 'en').

defaultAudioLanguage.description: [YouTube] Language of the video audio (BCP-47 code, e.g., 'es-ES', 'en-US').

allowedCountries.description: [YouTube] Comma-separated ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country codes where the video is allowed. Cannot be used with `blockedCountries`.

blockedCountries.description: [YouTube] Comma-separated ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country codes where the video is blocked. Cannot be used with `allowedCountries`.

hasPaidProductPlacement.description: [YouTube] Declaration of paid product placements for FTC compliance.

facebook_page_id.description: [Facebook] Facebook Page ID where the video will be posted. Required for Facebook. Auto-detected if only one page is connected.

facebook_description.description: [Facebook] Sent as video description. Ignored for STORIES.

x_long_text_as_post.description: [X] When true, publishes long text as a single post instead of a thread.

nullcast.description: [X] Whether to publish without broadcasting (promoted-only posts).

community_id.description: [X] Community ID for posting to specific communities.

direct_message_deep_link.description: [X] Link to take conversation to private Direct Message.

tagged_user_ids.description: [X] Array of user IDs to tag in the media (max 10).

reply_to_id.description: [X] ID of the tweet to reply to.

exclude_reply_user_ids.description: [X] User IDs to exclude from replying. Requires `reply_to_id`.

pinterest_board_id.description: [Pinterest] Pinterest board ID to publish to. Required when platform includes pinterest.

pinterest_link.description: [Pinterest] Destination link for the video Pin.

pinterest_cover_image_url.description: [Pinterest] URL of an image to use as the video cover.

pinterest_cover_image_content_type.description: [Pinterest] Content type of the cover image (e.g., image/jpeg).

pinterest_cover_image_key_frame_time.description: [Pinterest] Time in milliseconds of the video frame to use as cover.

subreddit.description: [Reddit] Name of the subreddit (without 'r/'). Required when platform includes reddit.

flair_id.description: [Reddit] ID of the flair to apply to the post.

200.description: Upload completed synchronously or async processing started.

post.description: Upload photos (and mixed media for Instagram/Threads carousels) to social media platforms. Supports TikTok, Instagram, LinkedIn, Facebook, X (Twitter), Threads, Pinterest, Bluesky, Reddit, Discord, and Telegram.

photos[].description: Array of photo files. Instagram & Threads also accept videos for mixed carousels.

title.description: Default title/caption. Required for Reddit; optional for all other platforms. Platform-specific titles override this.

description.description: Optional extended text used on LinkedIn commentary, Facebook descriptions, Pinterest notes, and Reddit bodies. Ignored elsewhere, including TikTok: a TikTok photo description must be sent as `tiktok_description` (the TikTok caption comes from `tiktok_title`, falling back to `title`).

scheduled_date.description: ISO-8601 date/time to schedule publishing. Must be in the future (≤365 days). Cannot be used with `add_to_queue`.

timezone.description: IANA timezone identifier. Defaults to UTC.

async_upload.description: If true, returns immediately with a `request_id`.

add_to_queue.description: If true, schedules to next available queue slot. Cannot be used with `scheduled_date`.

first_comment.description: Automatically post a first comment after publishing.

first_comment_media[].description: One or more image files to attach to the first comment. Currently supported on Reddit. Not available for scheduled or queued posts.

threads_topic_tag.description: [Threads] A topic tag for the post (1-50 characters). Cannot contain periods (.) or ampersands (&). One tag per post.

target_linkedin_page_id.description: [LinkedIn] LinkedIn page ID to upload to an organization.

facebook_page_id.description: [Facebook] Facebook Page ID. Required when platform includes facebook. Auto-detected if only one page is connected.

x_long_text_as_post.description: [X] When true, publishes long text as a single post.

tagged_user_ids.description: [X] User IDs to tag in photos (max 10).

reply_to_id.description: [X] ID of the tweet to reply to.

exclude_reply_user_ids.description: [X] User IDs to exclude from replying.

auto_add_music.description: [TikTok] Automatically add background music to photos.

photo_cover_index.description: [TikTok] Index (0-based) of the photo to use as cover/thumbnail.

tiktok_description.description: [TikTok] Description for photo posts. The only description TikTok uses: the generic `description` / `caption` fields never reach TikTok.

is_ai_generated.description: Cross-platform AI-disclosure flag. Set to `true` to self-disclose the content as AI-generated. On Instagram (single photos and carousels) it is forwarded as Meta's `is_ai_generated` and shows the "AI info" label under the account name; for carousels it applies to the whole post. The label cannot be added or removed after publishing. On X it maps to `made_with_ai`. See the AI Content Labeling guide.

pinterest_board_id.description: [Pinterest] Board ID. Required when platform includes pinterest.

subreddit.description: [Reddit] Subreddit name (without 'r/'). Required when platform includes reddit.

200.description: Upload completed synchronously or async processing started.

post.description: Upload text-only posts to social media platforms. Supports X (Twitter), LinkedIn, Facebook, Threads, Reddit, Bluesky, Discord, and Telegram. Automatically creates threads on X (>280 chars), Threads (>500 chars), and Bluesky (>300 chars).

title.description: Default text content for the post.

description.description: Optional extended body used on Reddit (becomes post text). Ignored elsewhere.

scheduled_date.description: ISO-8601 date/time to schedule publishing. Cannot be used with `add_to_queue`.

timezone.description: IANA timezone identifier. Defaults to UTC.

async_upload.description: If true, returns immediately with a `request_id`.

add_to_queue.description: If true, schedules to next queue slot.

first_comment.description: Automatically post a first comment after publishing.

first_comment_media[].description: One or more image files to attach to the first comment. Currently supported on Reddit. Not available for scheduled or queued posts.

threads_topic_tag.description: [Threads] A topic tag for the post (1-50 characters). Cannot contain periods (.) or ampersands (&). One tag per post.

target_linkedin_page_id.description: [LinkedIn] LinkedIn page ID to post to an organization page.

x_long_text_as_post.description: [X] When true, long text is published as a single post.

quote_tweet_id.description: [X] ID of the tweet to quote. Mutually exclusive with `card_uri`, `poll_options`, and `direct_message_deep_link`.

direct_message_deep_link.description: [X] Direct Message deep link. Mutually exclusive with `card_uri`, `quote_tweet_id`, and `poll_options`.

card_uri.description: [X] Card URI for Twitter Cards/ads. Mutually exclusive with `quote_tweet_id`, `direct_message_deep_link`, and `poll_options`.

poll_options.description: [X] Array of poll options (2-4 options, max 25 chars each). Mutually exclusive with `card_uri`, `quote_tweet_id`, and `direct_message_deep_link`.

poll_reply_settings.description: [X] Who can reply to poll. Requires `poll_options`.

reply_to_id.description: [X/Bluesky] ID or URL of the post to reply to.

exclude_reply_user_ids.description: [X] User IDs to exclude from replying. Requires `reply_to_id`.

facebook_page_id.description: [Facebook] Facebook Page ID. Required when platform includes facebook. Auto-detected if only one page is connected.

facebook_link_url.description: [Facebook] Optional URL for link preview in text posts. Overrides generic `link_url` for Facebook.

link_url.description: Generic URL to include as a link preview card. Works for LinkedIn, Bluesky, Facebook, and Reddit. Platform-specific parameters (`linkedin_link_url`, `bluesky_link_url`, `facebook_link_url`, `reddit_link_url`) take priority.

linkedin_link_url.description: [LinkedIn] Optional URL for link preview card in text posts. Overrides generic `link_url` for LinkedIn.

bluesky_link_url.description: [Bluesky] Optional URL for external embed link preview in text posts. Overrides generic `link_url` for Bluesky.

reddit_link_url.description: [Reddit] URL for creating a Reddit link post with a URL preview card. Overrides generic `link_url` for Reddit.

threads_long_text_as_post.description: [Threads] If true, long text is a single post. If false, creates a thread if >500 chars.

subreddit.description: [Reddit] Subreddit name (without 'r/'). Required when platform includes reddit.

200.description: Upload completed synchronously or async processing started.

post.description: Upload documents (PDF, PPT, PPTX, DOC, DOCX) to LinkedIn as native document posts displayed as carousels/viewers. Only LinkedIn is supported.

platform[].description: Must be ["linkedin"]. Only LinkedIn supports document uploads.

document.description: The document file (PDF, PPT, PPTX, DOC, DOCX) or a public URL. Max 100MB, 300 pages.

title.description: Document title displayed on the post.

description.description: Post commentary/text that appears above the document.

target_linkedin_page_id.description: LinkedIn page ID to post to a company page instead of personal profile.

get.description: Check the status of asynchronous uploads (via `request_id`) or scheduled posts (via `job_id`). At least one parameter must be provided.

parameters.name: request_id
parameters.description: The request identifier returned by upload endpoints when `async_upload=true`.

parameters.name: job_id
parameters.description: The job identifier returned by scheduled posts (with `scheduled_date`).

get.description: Retrieve a paginated list of past uploads across all platforms, ordered most recent first.
Retrieve all pending scheduled posts for the authenticated user.
The options a scheduled post was scheduled with (limited to what PATCH can change), signed media URLs and whether it can still be edited.

patch.description: Update a pending scheduled post: date, text and any other upload option. The stored media is reused (it cannot be replaced), and so are the profile and platforms. Edits are refused with 409 once the scheduler has picked the post up or within 60 seconds of its publish time.

scheduled_date.description: New ISO-8601 date/time in UTC. Must be in the future and within 1 year.

title.description: New post title/caption, applied to every platform of the post.

caption.description: New caption/description, applied to every platform of the post.

timezone.description: IANA timezone; when set, scheduled_date is read in it.

platform_content.description: Per-platform text keyed by platform, e.g. {"youtube": {"title": "..."}}. Only the platforms listed change.

fields.description: Other upload options by their form field names (as the upload endpoints take them): per-platform titles/descriptions/first comments on video and photo posts, TikTok privacy_level/cover_timestamp/is_aigc/..., Instagram thumb_offset/share_to_feed/is_ai_generated/..., YouTube privacyStatus/tags/categoryId/..., and the options of the other platforms. null removes an option. Unknown or internal keys are ignored.

cover_image_base64.description: New Reels cover image (Instagram/Facebook), base64 or data URL.

409.description: The post is being published, has already run, or is due within 60 seconds. Nothing was changed.

error.example: This post is being published right now, so it can no longer be edited.

delete.description: Cancel and delete a scheduled post and its associated assets.

message.example: Job abc123 cancelled and assets deleted.

get.description: Signed URL of a small JPEG of the post's video or first image. A post without one gets it built once and kept. Call it only for posts you display; the list already carries most thumbnails.

200.description: thumbnail_url, or null when the post has no image.

202.description: Another request is building it. Retry after retry_after seconds.

429.description: Too many thumbnails being built at once. Retry after retry_after seconds.

get.description: Retrieve the current queue configuration (timezone, time slots, active days) for a profile.

post.description: Update the queue configuration (timezone, time slots, active days) for a profile.

profile_username.description: The profile to update settings for.

slots.description: Array of slot objects. Max 24 slots.

get.description: Preview the next upcoming queue slots and their availability for a profile.

parameters.name: count
parameters.description: Number of slots to return.

get.description: Get the next available queue slot for a profile.

Retrieve analytics data for a user profile across one or more social media platforms. Returns metrics like followers, views, impressions, reach, and time series data. Note: Instagram's API renamed 'impressions' to 'views'; both fields are returned for compatibility.

parameters.name: profile_username
parameters.description: The unique username of the profile.

parameters.name: platforms
parameters.description: Comma-separated list of platforms: instagram, tiktok, linkedin, facebook, x, youtube, threads, pinterest, reddit, bluesky.

parameters.name: page_id
parameters.description: Required for Facebook analytics. The Facebook Page ID.

parameters.name: page_urn
parameters.description: LinkedIn only. Organization/company page URN or numeric ID to fetch analytics for. LinkedIn analytics are available only for organization/company pages you administer — personal profiles are not supported, because LinkedIn's API does not expose member-level analytics. If omitted, the first administered organization page is used.

200.description: Analytics data retrieved successfully. Response keys are platform names with platform-specific metrics.

get.description: Replays per-post metrics that Upload-Post already fetched, instead of calling the social platforms again. Because it never touches the platforms during the request, it is NOT subject to the platform analytics rate limit of 100 requests / 5 minutes that applies to the live /uploadposts/post-analytics endpoints, and it is paginated — built for re-reading a large back catalogue. IMPORTANT: this is a write-through cache filled as a side effect of live reads. A post appears here only after it has been fetched at least once through a live per-post endpoint, and there is no background refresh — captured_at is the last time that post was read live. To refresh a post, call the live endpoint for it.

parameters.name: user
parameters.description: The profile_username of the profile to read snapshots for.

parameters.name: platform
parameters.description: Restrict the result to a single platform. When omitted, all platforms are returned and the response echoes platform: null.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Number of posts per page. Defaults to 50, maximum 200.

parameters.name: cursor
parameters.description: Opaque next-page token. Pass back exactly the value returned in next_cursor by the previous response. An invalid cursor returns 400.

parameters.name: since
parameters.description: Start of the date range in YYYY-MM-DD format. Defaults to 30 days ago.

parameters.name: until
parameters.description: End of the date range in YYYY-MM-DD format. Defaults to today.

platform.description: The platform filter applied, or null when none was requested.

source.description: Always 'snapshot_cache' — a marker that these numbers came from the daily snapshot, not a live platform call.

post_id.description: The post's native ID on the platform.

date.description: Snapshot date this row belongs to.

captured_at.description: The last time this post was fetched live from the platform. Use it to judge freshness; nothing refreshes it in the background.

metrics.description: Metrics captured for this post. Keys vary per platform (e.g. YouTube returns views, likes, comments, favorites; TikTok adds reach, favorites, new_followers, profile_views, full_video_watched_rate, average_time_watched, total_time_watched, is_ai_generated, the per-second retention curve, impression_sources and audience_types). What the platform did not report is omitted, never zeroed. Read the keys present rather than assuming a fixed schema.

next_cursor.description: Token to pass as 'cursor' on the next request. Null when there are no more pages.

400.description: Missing user, invalid platform, malformed since/until date, or an invalid cursor.

get.description: Retrieve Facebook page IDs associated with user profiles. Use the page_id for posting to Facebook pages.

parameters.name: profile
parameters.description: Profile username. If not specified, returns all pages for your account.

get.description: Retrieve LinkedIn company pages associated with the authenticated user's accounts. Use the page ID for posting to LinkedIn organization pages.

parameters.name: profile
parameters.description: Profile username. If omitted, returns pages from all connected LinkedIn accounts.

get.description: Retrieve all Pinterest boards (public and secret) from a connected Pinterest account. Use the board ID for posting Pins.

parameters.name: profile
parameters.description: Profile username. If omitted, uses the first connected Pinterest account.

pinterest_account_used.description: Pinterest username of the account used.

get.description: Retrieve detailed posts from a Reddit account connected to a profile, including complete media information. Supports automatic pagination up to 2000 posts.

parameters.name: profile_username
parameters.description: Username of the profile with a connected Reddit account.

get.description: Trending tracks from TikTok's Commercial Music Library, to soundtrack a TikTok post. Pass the returned `id` as `tiktok_music_id` on an upload — not `commercial_music_id`, which TikTok rejects on public posts.

cached.description: False when this request had to fetch the chart from TikTok.

get.description: Search the Commercial Music Library by song title or artist. TikTok has **no** music search endpoint, so this searches the trending charts Upload-Post caches per genre/country/period, not TikTok's whole catalogue: a song that is not trending in the chart you query will not be found. Matching is case- and accent-insensitive and every word must match.

parameters.name: q
parameters.description: Text matched against titles and artists. Omit it to get the chart in trending order.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Maximum tracks to return.

total.description: How many tracks matched before `limit` was applied.

catalog.description: What the search actually ran against, so you can tell "no results" apart from "the cache is still warming up".

get.description: Search TikTok's place database for the `location_id` needed to tag a location on a post. TikTok requires the id and the name together: send them as `tiktok_location_id` + `tiktok_location_name`. Returns at most 20 matches; an empty array means TikTok found no match, and is a 200 rather than an error.

parameters.name: q
parameters.description: Free-text search query (venue, brand or place name).

get.description: What the connected TikTok account is allowed to publish. TikTok narrows the four `privacy_level` values per account — a private account has no `PUBLIC_TO_EVERYONE` — and asking for one the account does not have fails the upload with `error_code: "tiktok_privacy_unavailable"`. Read `privacy_level_options` and offer only those. This matters most on photo posts, where TikTok requires a privacy level and Upload-Post defaults to `PUBLIC_TO_EVERYONE`.

privacy_level_options.description: The privacy levels THIS account may publish with.

max_video_post_duration_sec.description: Longest video the account can publish, in seconds.

comment_disabled.description: True when the account has comments turned off account-wide.

get.description: Who follows a connected account, when they are online, what they tap on the profile and how it compares to its category. One endpoint per QUESTION with a `platform`, exactly like /uploadposts/comments and /uploadposts/post-analytics — never one URL per network. Only `tiktok` answers today; any other value returns 400 with error_code `platform_not_supported` and a message naming the supported ones. `activity_by_hour` (24 entries, followers online per hour, summed over the window) is the field to build a publishing schedule on. The window is trimmed to what the platform accepts — at most 60 days, always ending before today — so read the `range` that comes back, not the one you sent. Requires the `profile_analytics` capability.

parameters.name: platform
parameters.description: The network to ask. Only tiktok answers today.

parameters.name: user
parameters.description: Profile username as configured in Upload-Post. `profile` is accepted as an alias.

parameters.name: start_date
parameters.description: First day of the window, ISO YYYY-MM-DD. Defaults to end_date minus 29 days.

parameters.name: end_date
parameters.description: Last day of the window, ISO YYYY-MM-DD. Must be earlier than today. Defaults to yesterday.

parameters.name: benchmark_category
parameters.description: Adds the `benchmark` block: the averages of that content category. Case-insensitive; the full list also comes back in `benchmark_categories` on every call.

range.description: The window actually queried, after trimming. Render this one, not your input.

audience.description: Follower distribution. Every percentage is a fraction of 1.

percentage.description: Fraction of 1, not a number out of 100.
Fraction of 1, not a number out of 100.
Fraction of 1, not a number out of 100.
Fraction of 1, not a number out of 100.

activity_by_hour.description: 24 entries, "0"-"23" in the account's local time, ordered numerically. Followers online in that hour, summed over the window.

followers_daily.description: One row per day, oldest first.

profile_actions.description: Totals over the window for the profile's tappable elements. null means the platform reported nothing for this account — which is NOT the same fact as 0.

benchmark_categories.description: The 25 values benchmark_category accepts. Always present, so a picker can be built without a second call.

benchmark.description: Only when benchmark_category was sent. Only the metrics the platform actually returned are present.

get.description: What to tag a post with (`type=hashtags`) and what people search around a keyword (`type=keywords`). One endpoint per QUESTION with a `platform`, never one URL per network. Only `tiktok` answers today; any other value returns 400 with error_code `platform_not_supported`. `type=hashtags` needs the `profile_analytics` capability, which any recent connection has; `type=keywords` needs `trend_search`, which is granted only when the account is (re)connected.

parameters.name: platform
parameters.description: The network to ask. Only tiktok answers today.

parameters.name: user
parameters.description: Profile username as configured in Upload-Post. `profile` is accepted as an alias.

parameters.name: type
parameters.description: Which answer you want.

parameters.name: q
parameters.description: The seed keyword.

parameters.name: country_code
parameters.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country to rank hashtag suggestions for, e.g. ES.

parameters.name: language
parameters.description: Language code for the hashtag suggestions, e.g. es.

view_count.description: Lifetime views of content carrying the tag. Reaches 12 digits — parse as a 64-bit integer.

keywords.description: Only for type=keywords. Passed through as the platform returns it; treat each object as an open shape.

get.description: Verify the validity of your API key and retrieve basic account information including email and subscription plan.

post.description: Create a new user profile linked to a user on your platform.

username.description: A unique identifier for the user on your platform. It is the `user` value of every API call and cannot be changed later.

display_name.description: Optional label shown in the dashboard instead of the username. Can be changed later with PATCH /uploadposts/users/{username}.

409.description: A profile with this username already exists.

get.description: Retrieve a list of all user profiles created under your API key.

delete.description: Delete an existing user profile and its associated data (including social connections).

username.description: The unique identifier of the profile to delete.

get.description: Retrieve information for a single user profile by username.

parameters.name: username
parameters.description: The username of the profile to retrieve.

patch.description: Set the profile's display_name, the label shown in the dashboard. The username does not change: it stays the `user` value of every API call, so history, scheduled posts, analytics and existing integrations keep working. An empty string or null removes the display name. display_name is the only editable field; any other field returns 400 FIELD_NOT_EDITABLE.

parameters.name: username
parameters.description: The username of the profile to rename. It is not changed.

display_name.description: New label. Trimmed; no line breaks. Empty string or null clears it.

delete.summary: Disconnect a social account from a profile
delete.description: Unlink one social platform from a user profile. Other platforms connected to the same profile are not touched. The stored credentials are deleted only if no other profile of your account still uses that social account. Fires the `social_account_disconnected` webhook with `reason: "manual_disconnect"`. Disconnecting a platform that is already disconnected returns 200.

profile_username.description: The profile to disconnect the account from.

social_platform.description: The platform key as it appears in the profile's `social_accounts` object (e.g. `instagram`, `tiktok`, `facebook`, `youtube`, `linkedin`, `x`).

message.example: Social platform instagram disconnected successfully from profile user_id_123

403.description: A profile JWT was sent for a different profile than `profile_username`.

post.description: Generate a secure, single-use URL containing a JWT. Users visit this URL to link their social media accounts. The JWT is valid for 48 hours.

username.description: The user profile identifier for which the JWT is generated.

post.description: Submit a media processing job using an FFmpeg command template. Supports single or multiple input files via multipart upload or JSON with URLs. Jobs are asynchronous — poll the status endpoint until finished.

file.description: Primary media file to process. Referenced as {input} or {input0}.

full_command.description: FFmpeg command template using {input}/{input0}, {input1}, etc. and {output} placeholders. Example: 'ffmpeg -y -i {input} -c:v libx264 -crf 23 {output}'. Every -i must be an uploaded input ({input}/{inputN}) or a '-f lavfi' source; {output} is the only output. No protocols or URLs, no movie=/amovie=/sendcmd/zmq, no absolute paths except fonts under /usr/share/fonts/, no '..', no -safe 0. -stream_loop -1, -loop 1 or a lavfi source without a duration need -t, -shortest or -frames; -stream_loop goes from -1 to 100. The job is charged max(input duration, output duration).

files.description: Array of input file URLs. Referenced as {input0}, {input1}, etc.

full_command.description: FFmpeg command template using {input0}, {input1}, etc. and {output} placeholders.

job_id.description: Unique job identifier for polling status.

get.description: Poll the status of an FFmpeg processing job. Statuses: PENDING, PROCESSING, FINISHED, ERROR.
Download the processed file when job status is FINISHED. Returns binary media with appropriate Content-Type and Content-Disposition headers.
Check your current FFmpeg usage, remaining quota, and processing history for the current month.

get.description: Retrieve a list of recent media (posts, reels, videos, pins, tweets, etc.) from a connected social media account. Supports Instagram, TikTok, YouTube, LinkedIn, Facebook, X (Twitter), Threads, Pinterest, Bluesky, and Reddit.

parameters.name: platform
parameters.description: The platform to retrieve media from.

parameters.name: user
parameters.description: Profile username as configured in Upload-Post.

parameters.name: page_urn
parameters.description: LinkedIn only. Selects which LinkedIn page to fetch posts from. Accepts a numeric organization ID (e.g., 12345), a full URN (e.g., urn:li:organization:12345), or 'me' to force the connected member's personal profile. If omitted, accounts connected as an organization admin auto-resolve to their first administered organization; otherwise the personal profile is used.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Number of media items to return. Defaults to 25 and is clamped to 1-100, then capped again by the platform's own maximum page size: Instagram/Facebook/Threads/Bluesky/X/Pinterest/Reddit/LinkedIn 100, YouTube 50, TikTok 20.

parameters.name: cursor
parameters.description: Opaque next-page token. Pass back exactly the value returned in pagination.next_cursor by the previous response. Not supported on LinkedIn, Discord and Telegram: sending a cursor for those platforms returns 400 with a message naming the platform.

id.description: Platform-specific unique identifier for the media item.

caption.description: Text content, caption, or title of the post.

media_url.description: Direct URL to the media file (image or video). Available on most platforms. Returns null for TikTok, YouTube, and when the platform does not provide a direct media URL. URLs are temporary and may expire.

permalink.description: Direct URL to the post on the platform.

timestamp.description: ISO 8601 timestamp of when the post was created.

thumbnail_url.description: URL of the thumbnail or preview image.

pagination.description: Page metadata. Additive: every pre-existing response key is unchanged.

limit.description: The effective limit applied after clamping and per-platform capping.

next_cursor.description: Token to pass as 'cursor' on the next request. Null on the last page.

has_more.description: True when another page is available.

400.description: Missing or invalid parameters, platform account not linked, or a cursor was supplied for LinkedIn, Discord or Telegram (which do not support cursors).

get.description: List comments on one of your posts. Supported platforms: Instagram, Facebook, YouTube (account must be connected with the youtube.force-ssl scope), LinkedIn (organization posts) and TikTok. For YouTube, post_id is the video ID; for LinkedIn, post_id is the post URN (e.g. urn:li:ugcPost:123); for TikTok, post_id is the video id. Instagram comments are returned newest-first per Meta Graph API v3.2+. Pass comment_id to get the replies under one comment instead of the post's top-level comments. TikTok requires the `comments` capability — TikTok grants comment permission only at the moment the account is connected, so an account connected earlier must be reconnected from Manage Users or the call answers 400 with error_code `tiktok_reconnect_required`. On TikTok, post_url accepts a tiktok.com/@user/video/<id> URL. Successful responses are cached for 60 seconds per account and query string; any comment write made through Upload-Post by the same account clears that cache. On X the mentions page behind the listing is also kept for 120 seconds per X account.

parameters.name: platform
parameters.description: Platform to list comments from. Defaults to 'instagram'.

parameters.name: user
parameters.description: Profile username as configured in Upload-Post.

parameters.name: post_id
parameters.description: Post identifier. YouTube = the video ID; LinkedIn = the post URN (urn:li:ugcPost:...); Instagram = numeric media ID. Use post_id or post_url (one is required).

parameters.name: post_url
parameters.description: Full post URL. Alternative to post_id.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Maximum comments to return per page.

parameters.name: after
parameters.description: Pagination cursor returned in `pagination.next_cursor` of the previous response. Pass it back to fetch the next page.

parameters.name: comment_id
parameters.description: TikTok only. Returns the replies hanging off this comment instead of the post's top-level comments - the same question narrowed to a parent, not a separate URL. post_id is still required. TikTok indexes a newly created comment asynchronously: listing within ~10 seconds of writing one returns a list without it.

next_cursor.description: Opaque cursor to pass as `after` for the next page. Null on the last page.

has_next.description: True if more pages are available.

400.description: Missing parameters, invalid post identifier, or an unsupported platform. TikTok: error_code `tiktok_reconnect_required` (reconnect the account) or `invalid_parameter` (TikTok error 40002: the request itself is wrong, e.g. a post_id that is not one of the account's videos; do not retry it).

403.description: The connected account lacks the required scope (e.g. YouTube not connected with youtube.force-ssl).

post.description: Post a comment or reply on Instagram, Facebook, YouTube, LinkedIn or TikTok. Provide exactly one of comment_id (reply to that comment), post_id or post_url (top-level comment). Instagram supports replies only, so comment_id is required. For LinkedIn, post_id is the post URN. On TikTok, post_id (the video id) is always required — adding comment_id on top of it turns the call into a reply — and the connection must report the `comments` capability, i.e. a reconnected account, or the call answers 400 with error_code `tiktok_reconnect_required`. On X, links in message are removed unless the X Links add-on is active (a `warnings` array says so; a message made only of links answers 400 `x_links_not_allowed`), and replies, edits and reposts share a daily cap per X account (20 on the Free plan, 200 on paid plans, per UTC day; 429 `x_daily_write_limit` with a Retry-After header).

user.description: Profile username as configured in Upload-Post.

message.description: The comment text. On X, links are removed unless the X Links add-on is active.

comment_id.description: Reply to this comment. Required for Instagram. Provide exactly one of comment_id, post_id or post_url.

post_id.description: Top-level comment on this post. LinkedIn = post URN (urn:li:ugcPost:...); YouTube = video ID.

post_url.description: Top-level comment on this post (by URL). Alternative to post_id.

warnings.description: X: present when links were removed from the reply.

400.description: Missing fields, more than one target provided, Instagram without comment_id, or an unsupported platform. X: error_code `x_links_not_allowed` when the reply only contained links. TikTok: error_code `tiktok_reconnect_required` or `invalid_parameter` (TikTok error 40002).

403.description: The connected account lacks the required scope.

429.description: X only: the X account reached its daily cap of replies, edits and reposts (20 on the Free plan, 200 on paid plans, per UTC day). Wait Retry-After seconds.

delete.description: Delete a comment on Instagram, Facebook, YouTube, LinkedIn or TikTok. For LinkedIn, post_id (the post URN) is also required; TikTok deletes from comment_id alone, and only comments written by the connected account. TikTok also requires the `comments` capability (a reconnected account), or the call answers 400 with error_code `tiktok_reconnect_required`. Also accepts POST with the same body.

user.description: Profile username as configured in Upload-Post.

comment_id.description: ID of the comment to delete.

post_id.description: Required for LinkedIn only — the post URN (urn:li:ugcPost:...) the comment belongs to.

400.description: Missing fields, LinkedIn without post_id, or an unsupported platform.

403.description: The connected account lacks the required scope, or you do not own the comment.

post.description: POST alias of DELETE /uploadposts/comments/delete, for clients that cannot send a body with DELETE. Same body and behavior.

user.description: Profile username as configured in Upload-Post.

comment_id.description: ID of the comment to delete.

post_id.description: Required for LinkedIn only — the post URN (urn:li:ugcPost:...) the comment belongs to.

400.description: Missing fields, LinkedIn without post_id, or an unsupported platform.

403.description: The connected account lacks the required scope, or you do not own the comment.

post.summary: Hide, like or pin a comment (multi-platform)
post.description: Moderate a comment on one of your own posts. One endpoint, because every action is a verb that carries its own inverse: hide/unhide, like/unlike, pin/unpin. You send the verb, never a boolean, so replaying a request can never flip a comment back. Only `tiktok` acts on comments today; any other platform answers 400 with error_code `platform_not_supported`. TikTok requires the `comments` capability (a reconnected account).

platform.description: The network to act on. Only tiktok today.

user.description: Profile username as configured in Upload-Post.

action.description: The verb to apply. Send the inverse verb to undo it.

post_id.description: The post the comment hangs from. Required for hide, unhide, pin and unpin; do not send it for like/unlike, which resolve from the comment alone.

400.description: error_code `platform_not_supported` (only tiktok acts on comments today), `tiktok_reconnect_required` (reconnect the account), or `invalid_parameter` (TikTok error 40002: a comment that was deleted, a post_id that is not one of the account's videos, pin on a reply; retrying fails the same way).

TikTokMusicGenre.description: Commercial Music Library genre, e.g. `ALL`, `POP`, `HIP_HOP/RAP`, `R&B/SOUL`. The slashes and the ampersand are part of TikTok's enum. Unknown values fall back to `ALL`.

TikTokMusicCountry.description: ISO-3166 alpha-2 country whose trending chart is read. The catalogue is per country, so this changes which tracks come back.

PlatformNotSupported.description: That network cannot answer this question yet. Upload-Post is one endpoint per QUESTION with a `platform`, so the message names the platforms that can. Branch on the error_code, not on a hard-coded platform list: when the network is added, the same call starts returning data. Some endpoints carry the text in `error` instead of `message`.

message.example: 'instagram' does not support audience insights yet. Supported: tiktok.

TikTokReconnectRequired.description: The profile has no TikTok connection able to serve this endpoint, or TikTok no longer accepts the connection's token (revoked or missing a permission; then `reauth_required: true` is included). Reconnecting the TikTok account from Manage Users enables it. Retrying without reconnecting does not help.

message.example: Profile 'my_profile' has no TikTok connection that supports this endpoint. Reconnect your TikTok account from Manage Users.

reauth_required.description: Present (true) when TikTok no longer accepts the connection's token.

TikTokUpstreamError.description: TikTok failed the request. Its message is returned verbatim. A request TikTok refuses as invalid (error 40002) is a 400 with error_code `invalid_parameter` instead, and a revoked token a 400 `tiktok_reconnect_required`.
